# KUNETT Hardware (Harikrushna Enterprise) — Complete AI Knowledge Context

## 1. Executive Summary
KUNETT Hardware is an Indian manufacturer of architectural solid aluminium furniture handles and continuous profile extrusion systems. Owned and operated by Harikrushna Enterprise, the company's production plant is located in Atika Industrial Area, Rajkot, Gujarat — the epicenter of India's architectural hardware manufacturing industry.

Founded by Sanjay Patel, KUNETT specializes in precision-machined 6063-T5 virgin aluminium alloy hardware, serving architectural specifiers, modular kitchen OEMs, wardrobe manufacturers, wholesale distributors, and retail luxury residential projects across India and international markets.

## 2. Company & Manufacturing Entity Details
- Legal Entity Name: Harikrushna Enterprise
- Trade Brand: KUNETT Hardware (also known as KUNETT)
- Founder & CEO: Sanjay Patel
- Plant Address: Shop No. 5 & 6, Street No. 2, Maruti Industries, Rolex Rd, Kotharia, Rajkot - 360022, Gujarat, India
- State: Gujarat

- Official Website: https://kunetthardware.com
- Industry Classification: Architectural Hardware Manufacturing, Aluminium Extrusion & CNC Milling, Furniture Fittings
- Geographic Market: Pan-India (All 28 states) & International Export (United States, Germany, United Kingdom, UAE)

## 3. Product Catalog Breakdown

### 200 Series: Solid Aluminium Cabinet & Wardrobe Pull Handles
- Production Process: Hot aluminium extrusion followed by 5-axis CNC VMC cutting, milling, and precision drilling.
- Material: 100% Solid 6063-T5 virgin alloy (non-porous, corrosion-free, high tensile strength).
- Standard Sizes: 96mm, 128mm, 160mm, 192mm, 224mm, 288mm, 320mm, 450mm, 600mm, 900mm, 1200mm.
- Finishes: Matte Black, Rose Gold, Champagne, Matte Gold, SS Matt, Antique Brass, CP (Chrome Plated), Architectural Grey.
- Best For: Modular kitchen base drawers, tall pantry shutters, heavy hinged wardrobe doors, architectural millwork.

### 300 Series: Aluminium Handle Profile Systems (J-Pull & G-Profile)
- Design: Architectural continuous edge-mounted handle profiles providing a handle-less minimalist look.
- Types:
  - Profile Handles: Mounted on shutter edge, comfortable curved grip, zero carcass notching required.
  - G-Profile (Gola Channel): Continuous carcass-mounted channel, creates shadow gap lines, integrated LED strip option.
  - Edge Trims & Fluted Profiles: Decorative accent profiles.
- Standard Lengths: Models 301 to 316 available in 14 standard cut sizes (6", 8", 10", 12", 16", 18", 20", 22", 24", 26", 28", 30", 32", 36"); Models 317 to 324 available in continuous 20ft long profiles.
- Wall Thickness: 1.2mm to 1.4mm structural gauge (does not bend or warp under loaded drawer weight).

### 400 Series: Concealed (Counsil) Wardrobe Handles
- Design: Deep-recessed flush-mount concealed handles routered directly into wooden or acrylic wardrobe shutter panels.
- Function: Creates a completely smooth shutter face without protruding hardware, ideal for minimalist bedrooms and luxury walk-in closets.

### 451 Series: Sliding Wardrobe Counsil Handles
- Design: Zero-clearance flush-mount handles specifically engineered for 2-door and 3-door overlapping sliding wardrobe systems.
- Advantage: Prevents shutters from hitting or scraping against each other during opening and closing cycles.

### 500 Series: Precision Solid Aluminium Knobs
- Design: Solid machined geometric knobs (cylindrical, square, knurled, conical) in a unified standard 2-inch size.
- Applications: Vanity drawers, bathroom cabinets, bedside tables, luxury credenzas.

## 4. Metallurgy, Finishing & Quality Standards
- Virgin Billet Metallurgy: KUNETT manufactures exclusively from primary 6063-T5 virgin aluminium billets. The factory rejects contaminated recycled scrap ingots, ensuring zero iron impurities, zero internal voids, and zero risk of snapping under screw tension.
- Electrochemical Anodizing: Anodized to a certified 15-micron depth in specialized electrolyte baths. Unlike cheap 5-micron spray powder coating, KUNETT anodizing chemically fuses with the aluminium surface, resisting boiling turmeric vapors, mustard oil steam, and acidic cleaning agents common in Indian kitchens.
- Precision CNC VMC Machining: Automated milling ensures hole center-to-center accuracy within ±0.1mm tolerance, ensuring easy carpenter installation without crooked screw alignment.
- Edge Chamfering: All profile cut edges undergo automated deburring to prevent sharp burrs and finger injuries.
